title: HB1953 (2025-2026 Regular Session): In firearms and other dangerous articles, further providing for licenses.
operative_text: Sec. 1 (amending 18 Pa.C.S. 6109(b)): If the applicant is a resident of this Commonwealth, he shall make application with the [sheriff of the county in which he resides] sheriff's office closest to the applicant's principal residence where the individual lives for the majority of the year and maintains as a permanent residence, or, if a resident of a city of the first class, with the chief of police of that city.
